[p-1a2b3c] SELinux blocked httpd_t (name_bind) on tcp port 8085: port not labeled for it
Waiting for your decision, found by basalt on 2026-10-04 10:15 UTC

  SELinux blocked httpd_t from using tcp port 8085 because the port is not
  labeled for it. SELinux denied httpd_t the name_bind permission on tcp port
  8085 (labeled unreserved_port_t), 2 times. If you apply it, the assistant
  will label tcp port 8085 as http_port_t.

What will run (exactly these commands, as root, in this order)
  $ semanage port -a -t http_port_t -p tcp 8085

Risk: medium (adds a lasting SELinux label for tcp port 8085).
Undo: a snapshot is taken before and after, so you can go back to the state
before the change; a rollback takes effect at the next boot.
  $ sudo basalt snapshots rollback --before p-1a2b3c

Next step
  Apply it:   sudo basalt apply p-1a2b3c
              (without a prompt: sudo basalt apply p-1a2b3c --yes --confirm e26848a3)
  Ignore it:  sudo basalt ignore p-1a2b3c

Evidence
  - raw: avc:  denied  { name_bind } for comm="nginx" scontext=system_u:system_r:httpd_t:s0
